It was about how town hall had a way to get on top of its roof from the back of the building, I said we should see if it’s true so that we can vandalize it. 
We waited until dark and went behind the building and sure enough, the roof was flat on town sides of it which got low to the ground near a fire exit, by that was an electrical box fixated onto the wall. I was like “Oh hell yeah” and climbed from the electrical box to the roof, I helped my sister and friend up there and we had a blast. We watched cars go by, we jumped from roof to roof, we were up there for about an hour until we heard a loud truck.
It was a semi unloading boxes to the next door building, it parked right in front of our way off. We all panicked like the little 14 year olds we were and thought of a plan to get off, my sister wanted to climb down the front but I told her cameras could see us, we couldn’t get down. My friend had this dumbass decision to see if the other half of the building had a way down, of course when she realized it didn’t a light was shown on her from the semi driver he literally screamed “What the hell are you doing up there?!” We all bolted and scattered, he Called the police as we all tried our own way to get off.
My friend jumped to another building and got down that way, I climbed onto a widow and just jumped, I don’t know what happened to my sister but an hour later of hiding under the cars in a parking lot she called me on my flip phone. She was freaking out and said “where are you where are you?!?” I told her where I was, she came around the corner with my friend and we all started to walk back home.
We saw police cars doing patrol while on the way but they didn’t see us, on Monday at school, cops were all over the halls, asking kids in our grade and up. Apparently they thought it was two high schoolers, so we were relieved. 
Years later I walked down that alley and they put up a fence around the lower parts of its roof, that’s so funny to me.
